clauses.clause: Death in any region respawns at that region's checkpoint (never level start), with the loadout, cure and boss state of that checkpoint.
clauses.note: At cure-disperse-ready the checkpoint has living boss HP 1116 low / 1072.8151 high; after fixture kills boss and causes ordinary player death, respawn reports boss dead at 0 HP in both tiers. Repro: npm run qa:accept -- --level L10 --skip-browser --reuse; inspect cure and boss HP/death snapshot at cure-disperse-ready in checkpoint receipts. Five other named checkpoint fixtures error per tier; their coverage remains open.

evidence.what: Mortal checkpoint fixture records the saved boss state and observed respawn state at cure-disperse-ready.
